notes.title: Steam Deck, Gamepad & Warehouse Updates
notes.notes: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558645/1248527a5b8b4190cbc78b807af08b1a078d2709.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🎮 Hello Figure Shop Simulator Community![/b][/h3][p]With the v0.3.0 update, we've introduced a range of new features, improvements, and bug fixes to further enhance your figure shop experience![/p][p]We're continuously working to make the game better by listening to your valuable feedback.[/p][p]Here’s what’s new in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🕹️ Steam Deck & Gamepad Support[/b][/h3][p]Many players requested it, and now it's here! You can now enjoy the game with full Steam Deck and gamepad support.[/p][p]Time to sit back, relax in your comfy chair, and keep those printers running.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558645/1ffca5fffbfddbe0f979ae409f46706f5ea77e77.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]📦 New Warehouse Expansions & Epic Figure Stock Shelves[/b][/h3][p]Managing your warehouse just got easier and more efficient:[/p][list][*][p]Two new warehouse expansions have been added, giving you more space and flexibility to organize your stock.[/p][/*][*][p]Dedicated stock shelves for Epic Figures allow you to store and manage these special items separately with ease.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🧑‍🔧 Worker Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Workers now automatically place the filament you purchase into the correct storage shelves.[/p][/*][*][p]A new manual toggle lets you set each worker’s status to “working” or “not working” individually.[/p][/*][/list][p]But that’s not all! In future updates, we plan to introduce new worker types that will handle 3D printers directly, making your job even easier.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🛠️ Improvements & Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]You can now remove price cards. When removed, workers will no longer restock that shelf.[/p][/*][*][p]When hovering over shelves or price cards, the figure’s name and quality will now be displayed on screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several behavior bugs that caused customers to get stuck.[/p][/*][*][p]Epic figure production time has been reduced, now you can craft them faster than ever![/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: HotFix 0.2.9
notes.notes: [p]Fixed an issue that prevented workers from restocking display shelves.[/p][p]Resolved a model mix-up on the store window for Epic sets.[/p]

notes.title: Epic Sets & Decoration
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558645/1248527a5b8b4190cbc78b807af08b1a078d2709.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3]🎉 Hello Figure Shop Simulator Community![/h3][p]With the v0.2.8 update, we've introduced many new features, improvements, and bug fixes to further enhance your figure shop experience![/p][p]We've been carefully listening to your feedback and continue to improve the game step by step. Here's what's new in this update:[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]👑 Epic Printer & Epic Figures[/h3][p]As promised, the long-awaited Epic Printer and Epic Figures are now available![/p][list][*][p][b]Epic Printer[/b]: Unlike standard printers, this one allows you to produce exclusive figure sets only available through it—upgrade your shop to the next level![/p][/*][*][p][b]Epic Figures[/b]: Larger and more impressive designs! These figures are sure to become collector favorites.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558645/6c710ad2a64d3322f15f15905ebb0299b302cef4.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🖌️ Decoration Features[/h3][p]Your shop is now [i]truly[/i] your own!
With the new update:[/p][list][*][p]You can paint the [b]walls, floor, and ceiling[/b] of your shop and storage area in different colors.[/p][/*][*][p]Customize the atmosphere of your shop to match your own style![/p][/*][/list][p]More wall and floor options will be added in future updates—this is just the beginning![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45558645/3a8a8c41a0c5034bc03324cbb928c23fa0e855d8.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🕒 Working Hours Update[/h3][p]We reviewed your feedback and made some adjustments to the shop hours:[/p][list][*][p]Customers now visit your shop between [b]07:00 and 19:00[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]From [b]19:00 to 00:00[/b], the shop is closed to customers, but you can continue producing figures.[/p][/*][/list][p]This means an extra [b]2 hours of production time at night[/b] for those who prefer nighttime crafting—fill up your stock and be ready for the next day![/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]🛠️ Improvements & Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]You can now [b]refill boxes[/b] on storage shelves—stock management is more flexible![/p][/*][*][p]Employees now prioritize boxes with the [b]fewest figures[/b] inside.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where customers could get [b]stuck between shelves[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]When you purchase a new product license, customers [b]won’t immediately request[/b] the new items. This gives you more time to prepare and plan your production accordingly.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p]

notes.title: HotFix 0.2.6
notes.notes:
Fixed an issue where figures were listed incorrectly on the Storage Board.

Added new resolution options in the settings.

Added an on/off toggle for ambient sounds in the settings panel.

Fixed a bug where clicking on a price tag would reset the price.

notes.title: 🎉 Figure Shop Simulator is now available in Early Access! 🎉
notes.notes: [p]Start your journey today. Build your figure shop, produce custom figures, manage your store, and grow your business from the ground up. [/p][p][/p][p]This is just the beginning. Your feedback will help us shape the future of the game as development continues.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3604560/Figure_Shop_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]If you’d like to check out our upcoming project as well, you can wishlist it here:[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3753880/Game_Saloon_Simulator/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks again for your support![/p]
